about: Step 9 difficulty targets (handoff/phase9/plan.md section 1 B), read by verify/tools/balance/check_targets.py and by the run harness (verify/suites/p9/c-bosspilot-run, MODE=outliers reads B9.named). Every target names its source and how it follows from R0. Rates are the run player's win rate per fight with the fair AI on both sides.

seeds.source: plan section 1 (seed bases): S1 is the calibration base, S2 the held-out base; final acceptance runs on S2 only. The values are this harness's (SEED_BASE); each mode adds its own offset (slots 1000000 x band, finale 3000000, tekahn 4000000, outliers 5000000, longrun 6000000, treasure 7000000, named 8000000), so the ranges never meet.

acceptance.source: plan section 1 B: every band needs n >= 200 (Tekahn n = 100); a band passes when its Wilson 95% interval overlaps the band and its point estimate lies within the band +- 3 points. A smaller n is reported as indicative (check_targets.py prints 'n below').

R0.source: plan section 1 B, R0: a fresh-profile Victory rate of 1-3% on each schedule, the product of the measured slot rates over the schedule's fights (acts I-III: 4 combat floors and a major each; the finale: 4 Heist fights on acts-v4h, Tekahn on acts-v4t).
R0.derivation: R0 = B1^4 x B2 x B3c^4 x B3m x B4c^4 x m3 x F, where m3 = (1 - lambda) x B4m + lambda x k1 is the act III major's rate (lambda the draw's Plague Lord share of the act III major, k1 the lord's one-attempt kill rate, B5's midpoint 0.175) and F = B6^4 (acts-v4h) or B7 (acts-v4t). At the point targets this is 2.0% / 2.2% with lambda 0, 1.78% / 1.96% with lambda 0.175 and 1.20% / 1.31% with lambda 0.6: the plan's 'about 1.2% (v4h) and 1.4% (v4t)' holds for a lord share of about 0.6 / 0.5. check_targets.py computes the product from the measured slot rates, where the measured act III major rate already mixes the lords in at the drawn share, and reports the share it saw.

bands.source: plan B1 (act I combat, per fight, floors 1-4)
bands.derivation: R0's first factor: 4 fights at 0.92 survive at 0.72; the band keeps the product of act I (B1^4 x B2) within 0.42-0.65

bands.source: plan B2 (act I major); design D4's act I major wall (levers: the floor-5 curve, LOOT finals to major2, offsetCap last)
bands.derivation: R0 factor; act I survival B1^4 x B2 = 0.50 at the points
R0 factor; act II survival B3c^4 x B3m = 0.36 at the points
R0 factor; act III survival B4c^4 x m3

bands.source: plan B4 (act III major, custom finals)
bands.derivation: R0 factor (the non-lord part of m3); the Plague Lords are B5's

B5.source: plan B5 (Plague Lord, act III major): mean damage per attempt >= 60; one-attempt kill 10-25%
B5.derivation: a lord is meant to take several runs (persistent damage), so its one-attempt rate replaces B4m in m3 at the drawn share

B6.source: plan B6 (Heist finale): 0.80 per fight, all four in one run >= 0.35
B6.derivation: F = B6^4 = 0.41 at the point; the joint rate is counted over the runs whose four fights were all played (finale9 plays each fight of run g on the same seed)

B7.source: plan B7 (Tekahn finale, n = 100): 0.45; turn caps <= 3 of 100
B7.derivation: F on acts-v4t; 0.45 against the Heist finale's 0.41 keeps the two schedules' R0 within 0.2 points

B8.source: plan B8: act I combat beats act III combat (one-sided test, p < 0.05); adjacent acts are ordered by point estimate, a reversal of <= 3 points tolerated
B8.derivation: the point targets fall by act (0.92 > 0.88 > 0.84; 0.70 > 0.60 > 0.55)

B9.source: plan B9: every t3/t4 row plus the 17 named outliers, n = 20 each, on their act's combat slot; flagged when the Wilson interval lies entirely above 0.98 or entirely below 0.45; rows flagged room are exempt (reward nodes)
B9.derivation: a row outside these limits moves its slot's rate by more than the band's width at its draw share
B9.namedNote: The plan counts 17 named outliers but no list of them is recorded in the tree (plan, implementation.md, values.md, the phase-8 reports). 'named' is left empty until the list is supplied; outliers9 then samples every t3/t4 row only. BOSS=id,id samples any rows instead.

B10.source: plan B10: longrun9, 240 runs, every fight played, stratified by origin; the run-depth distribution matches the depth predicted from the measured slot rates (each floor's survival within its CI); no Victory count requirement
B10.derivation: predicted survival to floor f = the product of the measured slot rates of floors 1..f-1

B11.source: plan B11: the rate of reaching the act II major per origin (Monster Hunt, Heist, Rumble, Tombs, classes; n >= 40 each from longrun9) is within +-15 points of the pooled rate
B11.derivation: one economy (D6): no origin should be carried or held back by its treasures
